qualification: Ground joins at the complete northern canopy and northern container apron extent. Retained source heights within1.25m ofDGM and source slopes<=0.7 are accepted. Isolated returns whose available immediate neighbours all differ by more than0.25m vertically are rejected. Missing source returns remain explicit. Short bounded missing runs may use explicitly recorded interpolated residuals; raw delta and sourceHeightMC remain null at those points.
coordinateSystem: EPSG:25832; residual metres sourceMC.y minus DGM1 MC.y

rejectedDiscontinuities.reason: No adjacent accepted source ground within0.25m vertical difference at <=0.25m sample spacing; isolated surface discontinuity.

gapInterpolation.qualification: Linear interpolation of residuals across short bounded gaps using neighbouring accepted ground. These are estimated joining heights, not provider observations. Longer gaps and abrupt residual differences remain unresolved.
